newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midco gasoline basis up on tight stocks.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midco gasoline basis up on tight stocks.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent spot unleaded gasoline basis firmed on Thursday on perceptions of tightening supplies in the wake of a drawdown in stocks and shipping delays on a key regional pipeline, traders said.
Trade was thinned by a pair of industry outings that pulled players out of the market, which some traders said was keeping basis values artificially high.
"I think it's a bit thin so these values are inflated somewhat," one trader said.

Midwest PADD 2 refiners reported an estimated 1.48 million barrel draw in gasoline on hand last week, and deliveries on the Explorer Houston-to-Chicago pipeline earlier were pushed back five days by maintenance and a heavy slate of liftings.
The Williams pipeline system, a key barometer of Group Three stocks, also was maintaining a relatively thin 17-day supply of gasoline, traders said.
Group Three unleaded was bid 1.75 cents a gallon over June NYMEX unleaded for prompt May deliveries and 0.50 cent over the print for later deliveries, traders said.
Chicago unleaded was bid 0.25 cent a gallon over the print for prompt deliveries and even with the print for later deliveries, with premium holding at a strong 5.50 cent a gallon higher.
Group Three high sulphur diesel for May deliveries was talked 6.0/6.25 cents a gallon over June NYMEX heating oil, with Chicago high sulphur bid 2.25/2.50 cents over the print.
